questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "rally" mean?
options: A quick increase in stock prices
A sudden drop in stock prices
questions.explain_en: Here "rally" refers to a rapid rise in the market, meaning stock prices went up.
questions.explain_zh: 在文中「rally」指的是股市快速上漲，表示股價上升。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan stocks notch record closing high as AI leaders power the index

questions.question: Which two companies were mentioned as climbing together in the market?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that foundry giant TSMC and assembler Hon Hai (Foxconn) climbed together.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明晶圓代工巨頭台積電 (TSMC) 與組裝大廠鴻海 (Foxconn) 同時上漲。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan stocks notch record closing high as AI leaders power the index

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word “accelerator” mean?
options: A device that speeds up processing
A type of stock that rises quickly
A financial bonus given to employees
A marketing campaign to attract customers
questions.explain_en: Here “accelerator” refers to an AI accelerator, a chip that makes computing faster.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的 “accelerator” 指的是 AI 加速器，能讓運算速度提升的晶片。
questions.news_title_en: TSMC's September revenue hits a fresh same-period record on AI demand

questions.question: By what percentage did TSMC's September revenue increase compared to the same month last year?
questions.explain_en: The summary states September revenue was up 54.6% from a year earlier.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明，九月營收較去年同期增長了 54.6%。
questions.news_title_en: TSMC's September revenue hits a fresh same-period record on AI demand

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "resilience" mean?
options: The ability to recover quickly from difficulties
questions.explain_en: Resilience refers to the ability to bounce back or recover quickly after a setback, especially in finance.
questions.explain_zh: 韌性指的是在遭遇困難後能快速恢復的能力，尤其在金融領域。
questions.news_title_en: FSC chair sets out six policy priorities, including a finance-sector LLM

questions.question: When is the finance-industry large language model planned to be released?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the model is targeted for release in the first quarter of 2027.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明該大型語言模型預計在2027 年第一季推出。
questions.news_title_en: FSC chair sets out six policy priorities, including a finance-sector LLM

questions.question: In the news, what does the term "ex-dividend" mean?
options: A special tax applied to dividend income
The date when a company announces a new dividend amount
The date when a security is sold without the right to receive the next dividend
questions.explain_en: "Ex-dividend" is the day a stock or ETF trades without the right to the upcoming dividend, so buyers after that date won't receive it.
questions.explain_zh: 「除息日」是指證券在此日期之後交易，買進者將無法取得即將發放的股息。
questions.news_title_en: October brings a wave of ETF ex-dividend dates for income investors

questions.question: How many Taiwan‑listed ETFs are scheduled to go ex‑dividend in October 2026?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that about 48 Taiwan‑listed ETFs go ex‑dividend in October 2026.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中提到約有 48 檔台灣上市 ETF 於 2026 年十月除息。
questions.news_title_en: October brings a wave of ETF ex-dividend dates for income investors

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "anchoring" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "anchoring" means keeping inflation expectations steady and stable.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的「anchoring」指的是讓通膨預期保持穩定。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan's central bank holds its policy rate at 2% for a 10th straight quarter

questions.question: How many consecutive quarters has Taiwan's central bank kept the policy rate unchanged?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the hold now spans ten consecutive quarters.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明政策利率已連續十個季度維持不變。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan's central bank holds its policy rate at 2% for a 10th straight quarter

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "margin" mean?
options: The profit left after costs are paid
questions.explain_en: "Margin" refers to the profit that remains after a company pays its costs, especially in transport and manufacturing.
questions.explain_zh: 「margin」指的是在扣除成本後剩下的利潤，特別是運輸和製造業的利潤。
questions.news_title_en: Oil prices climb to a multi-year high, pressuring global equities

questions.question: According to the summary, how long has it been since crude oil reached this price level?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that crude oil prices rose to their highest level in more than four years.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說原油價格升至四年多以來的最高水平。
questions.news_title_en: Oil prices climb to a multi-year high, pressuring global equities
